
### Imports & Loading
```{python}
import pandas as pd
triplets_full = pd.read_parquet("../data/triplets_full.parquet")
```

### Finding definition of RT
```{python}

triplets_full.head()
print(triplets_full["RT"].max())
print(triplets_full["RT"].min())
print(triplets_full["RT"].max() + (triplets_full["RT"].min()*-1))

print(triplets_full["RT"].mean())

print(triplets_full["RT"][triplets_full["RT"] < 0].count()) # only 15 of them are below 0, probably ignorable!

print(triplets_full["RT"][triplets_full["RT"] > 1000000].count()) # only 8, data quality thing
```
RT appears to be miliseconds reaction time. Some data quality issues at the extreme ends.
